steps.code:
# Get all liked songs (paginate through all pages)
liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total liked songs: {len(liked_songs)}")
liked_song_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in liked_songs}
print("Liked song IDs:", liked_song_ids)

steps.code:
# Get current song and check if it's liked
current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
print("Current song:", current)

# Loop until we find a liked song
max_steps = len(apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token))  # queue length
steps = 0
while current['song_id'] not in liked_song_ids and steps < max_steps:
    print(f"Song {current['title']} (ID {current['song_id']}) not liked, going to previous...")
    prev_result = apis.spotify.previous_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Previous result:", prev_result)
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("New current song:", current)
    steps += 1

if current['song_id'] in liked_song_ids:
    print(f"Found liked song: {current['title']} (ID {current['song_id']})")
else:
    print("No liked song found in queue cycle")
